inputs: 1차는 새 이미지 생성. 후속 시안은 직전 생성물만 참조. 공식 로고는 생성 모델에 넣지 않고 최종 조판에서 원본 PNG를 사용.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE exceptionally art-directed, photorealistic Korean instant-rice future-lifestyle advertising photograph, vertical 4:5 aspect ratio, ideally 2160 by 2700. No lettering, no logos anywhere; graphic typography will be professionally added later.

The central visual idea is that peeling open an instant rice bowl also peels back an entire space-consuming kitchen, opening up room for a person's life. It must look like an intelligent premium conceptual photograph, not fantasy concept art or a miniaturized world.

Composition: wide-angle but refined architectural photography, eye level slightly above a dining table, a bright warm compact Korean home in the near future. In the lower right foreground a believable normal-sized round shallow white ribbed microwave rice tray stands on a clean oak dining table. Beautiful delicious freshly cooked short-grain white rice with distinct tender translucent glossy grains, gentle visible warm steam. A single realistic adult hand from the right edge is pulling the plain silver foil seal upward by its corner. The rice is hygienic and completely separate from everything else.

The ONE impossible transformation: the lifted foil seal flows in one elegant continuous S-shaped sheet away from the bowl into the room, expanding by forced perspective to room scale; this huge sheet carries a clearly recognizable monochrome pale-grey compact kitchen folded UPWARD along architectural origami creases: a sink, curved faucet, two cabinet fronts and one cooking pot, all cleanly embedded on the same folding sheet. The kitchen is visibly folding away toward the upper RIGHT of the room. Realistic soft silver underside and sharply defined paper-thin architectural fold edges. Only one coherent sheet and clear flowing curve, no ribbon knots or random melting. The grey kitchenette is deliberately quieter than the warm human space it reveals. Keep the folded kitchen in the middle and right, well BELOW the empty top headline zone.

Under the raised kitchen sheet, normal full-sized fictional Korean father and small daughter, seen in profile/back with no prominent face, joyfully making and flying one paper airplane in the liberated sunny living floor space. Candid natural body language, lovely but not sentimental stock-photo acting. The father kneels at the child's height, both feet/legs and anatomically believable hands. They occupy the central midground. Warm maple wood floor, small sunlit window on the far right showing a gentle optimistic future city roof garden, no flying cars, no screens. A couple of little side-dish plates next to the foreground rice tray, no elaborate food spread. The room is recognizably a real apartment with real floor/wall/window scale, and the people are NORMAL size standing on the actual floor, NOT inside the rice bowl, NOT miniatures, NOT standing on food.

Lighting and materials: extraordinary natural golden afternoon light pouring from right, beautiful long soft floor shadows, fine warm plaster walls, tactile maple floor, warm cream and small vermilion-red accents. Clean crafted editorial realism with the single controlled architectural impossibility, physical shadows, convincing rice/foil/skin optics. Sophisticated restrained colors, no sci-fi blue, no game render, no magical particles, no grain people, no surreal food textures.

Reserve the TOP 25 percent of the image as simple warm ivory plaster/empty space for a logo and two-line headline. Upper left especially completely clean. The dramatic image occupies the middle and lower 75 percent. Preserve a narrow clean lower margin too. Make the rice tray large and eye-catching but not grotesquely huge: approximately 32 percent of frame width, fully in frame. No readable text, no numbers, no logos, no watermark.

Edit the supplied photograph into a MUCH WIDER, compact 4:5 advertising poster composition. OUTPUT CANVAS MUST be 4:5 width:height, for example 1600 pixels wide by 2000 high. The supplied source is excessively tall; EXPAND THE SCENE TO BOTH SIDES and recompose, do NOT retain its tall narrow shape, do NOT crop out the rice, kitchen, hand or family. No bars or borders.

Preserve the attractive natural food photography, warm sunlight, delicious white short-grain rice, single hand peeling the silver foil, and candid father and daughter with a paper airplane. Fix the main weakness: the floating kitchen currently reads as a dangerous overhead slab. Make it clearly a clean lightweight architectural origami sheet folding AWAY toward the RIGHT WALL, with a safe spacious play area on the left. No heavy furniture hovering above people's heads. The recognizable sink/faucet/cabinet surfaces should be thin, coherent and neatly folding into the right wall, with no open pipes, mess or debris. Use ONE precise graceful visual match: the curved edge of the real, normal-sized foil lid in the lower right points along the same sweeping curve as the receding folded kitchen in the upper right. The silver is delicate, luminous, controlled rather than dominating. A visual metaphor of a future home giving space back to people.

Detailed compact layout on 4:5 canvas: Top 23% plain warm light cream wall for later headline and official logo. Middle-right (x 50-96%, y 27-60%) the kitchen folding into the wall with a refined architectural paper-thin curve. Middle-left (x 14-48%, y 49-75%) father kneeling with daughter enjoying one flying white paper airplane, fully sized and physically plausible on the sunny wood floor. Normal-sized food tray in extreme foreground lower right (x 52-95%, y 75-94%), fully visible with a realistic shallow round ribbed white instant-rice tray, glossy steaming rice and hand carefully lifting the edge by the dry tab. Two small delicious side dish plates left of it. Keep spacious sunny real home, a modest built-in future garden window at far right with an airy softly receding skyline. Gorgeous food texture, believable hands and legs, 35mm editorial photographic realism. Color scheme warm ivory, honey wood, soft silver and a tiny vermilion accent. No orange cast.

Absolutely no text, logos, letters or numbers. No miniatures, no people inside food, no cities in bowls, no computer interfaces, no flying cars, no distressed/dirty surfaces. A single seamless photograph, not a collage or triptych.

Precisely refine this advertising photograph. Keep its compact 4:5 aspect ratio and its warm realistic home, joyful father and daughter on the left, single paper airplane, hand opening a round instant-rice tray in the foreground, and clean empty upper-left area for lettering. Do NOT add any lettering or logos.

CRITICAL art-direction correction: the right-hand kitchen currently looks like a normal kitchen hanging from a slightly curved wall. Replace ONLY that kitchen/wall transformation with a visually unmistakable, SAFE, elegant ARCHITECTURAL ACCORDION FOLD. The entire small pale grey kitchenette is a VERY THIN paper-like architectural panel folding laterally into the far-right wall, like opening a pop-up book in reverse. Show THREE clear alternating broad mountain/valley origami creases, not a thick floating slab or cube cabinets. The countertop, cupboard fronts and sink should be neatly integrated into the folded thin panel, with ONE modest curved faucet visible as a recognizable kitchen cue. Remove the large overhead range hood and the loose heavy saucepan/pots. No heavy objects above the family. All folds are attached to the right wall; there is plenty of reassuring empty floor between the retracting kitchenette and the people.

The slim bottom edge of this origami kitchen sheet should flow to meet the delicate normal-sized foil seal that the hand peels off the instant-rice tray, creating ONE continuous flowing direction. The foil seal is not a giant thick ribbon; it is fine, plausible, luminous, with no extra loops. Keep all food completely separate from the architectural material.

Also correct the cooked rice realism: premium Japanese/Korean short-grain rice, individual grains are subtly elongated ovals, varied and irregular, plump but not round pearl pellets, tiny natural dimples, restrained gloss and a few delicate rising wisps of real warm steam. The tray should be shallow and wider than it is tall, authentic 210g microwave-rice container proportions, finely ribbed white sides, NOT a deep soup bowl. Retain the delicious kimchi and green vegetable side dishes on the table at the left. The main tray must be fully in frame with clean rim.

Color mood should be warm white sunlight and pale honey wood, slightly less amber/yellow. High-end architectural and food photography, natural skin and foil optical texture. No sci-fi overlays or UI, no glitter, no miniatures, no figures in the food. This is ONE seamless conceptual photo. Preserve an empty uncluttered light warm ivory top-left area, about 40% of the width and upper 25% of the height, for logo and headline. Canvas exactly 4:5, width:height 0.8.

Make one localized advertising art-direction edit to the RIGHT-SIDE KITCHEN ONLY in the provided photograph. Keep the entire rest of the photo unchanged: father and daughter, paper airplane, sunny floor, window, hand, foil, rice and side dishes, upper-left empty wall, 4:5 canvas.

The kitchen currently has decorative folded upper cupboards but its sink countertop and LOWER cupboards remain straight and horizontal. That is the specific flaw. Change the actual lower countertop and lower cupboard panel to a bold, unmistakable Z-shaped architectural accordion collapsing toward the RIGHT wall. The kitchen itself must be folding, not just its hood.

Art direction: treat the entire kitchenette as a clean 3mm-thick sculptural white architectural pop-up model of a kitchen, still room-sized, physically attached to the right wall. There should be TWO LARGE sharp folding hinges across the lower cupboard/counter plane, creating 3 clearly tilted planes and dark wedge-shaped shadows between them. A recognizable small sink and ONE curved faucet belong to one tilted plane and MUST TILT WITH THAT PLANE, not remain horizontal. The leftmost folded face tilts back about 40 degrees; the middle face returns forward about 45 degrees; the rightmost face folds almost flat against the far right wall. Clear thick-light/dark-light rhythm, crisp origami silhouette, no melting or vague curves. No real thick kitchen furniture, no exposed pipes, no falling heavy pots, no extra appliances. Preserve the existing thin silver foil edge's clean visual flow down toward the real rice seal at the bottom right, but keep that connector narrow and graceful.

Make the folded whole kitchen occupy only the rightmost 20-25% of the frame, leaving the people's area wide, safe and sunny. The thin sheet's origami structure is an intentional impossible visual metaphor of space returned to people. Keep excellent photographic realism on the FOOD and people, and physical sunlight/shadows on the architectural folded sheet. No text, no logo, no watermark, no extra objects or people. Do not change the good natural cooked-rice texture, normal tray and hand.
